itemId.description: The credit type id; courses and certification paths refer to it.

name.description: The name, such as CPD hours; types are matched by id, then by name.

unit.description: The unit shown after an amount, such as hours.

allowExternalLearning.description: Whether people can record external learning of this type.

CreditTypes.description: The credit types to create, or update by id or name.
